GAP Bond Manager Exported Functions

group GAP_BOND_MANAGER_Exported_Functions

Functions

bool gap_get_gap_bond_manager(void)

Check whether GAP Bond Manager is enabled.

Return values:

  • true -- GAP Bond Manager is enabled.

  • false -- GAP Bond Manager is disabled.

Returns:

Check result.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_bond_authen_result_confirm(uint8_t *bd_addr, T_GAP_REMOTE_ADDR_TYPE remote_addr_type, T_GAP_KEY_TYPE key_type, T_GAP_CFM_CAUSE cause)

When receiving APP_BOND_MGR_LE_AUTHEN_RESULT_IND, APP can call this API to confirm authentication result.

Parameters:

  • bd_addr -- [in] Remote bluetooth device address.

  • remote_addr_type -- [in] Remote bluetooth device address type.

  • key_type -- [in] Key type.

  • cause -- [in] User confirm result.

Return values:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure.

Returns:

Operation result.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_bond_authen_key_req_confirm(uint8_t *bd_addr, T_GAP_REMOTE_ADDR_TYPE remote_addr_type, uint8_t key_len, uint8_t *p_key, T_GAP_KEY_TYPE key_type, T_GAP_CFM_CAUSE cause)

When receiving APP_BOND_MGR_LE_AUTHEN_KEY_REQ_IND, APP can call this API to confirm authentication key request.

Parameters:

  • bd_addr -- [in] Remote bluetooth device address.

  • remote_addr_type -- [in] Remote bluetooth device address type.

  • key_len -- [in] Key length to set.

  • p_key -- [in] Pointer to key to set.

  • key_type -- [in] Key type.

  • cause -- [in] User confirm result.

Return values:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool gap_update_cccd_info(uint16_t conn_handle, uint8_t data_len, uint8_t *data)

When receiving APP_BOND_MGR_GATT_SERVER_STORE_IND, and the parameter op is GATT_STORE_OP_GET_CCC_BITS, APP shall call this API to update the CCCD information.

Parameters:

  • conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle of the ACL link.

  • data_len -- [in] The length of the updated CCCD data.

  • data -- [in] Point to the updated CCCD data.

Return values:

  • true -- Operation success.

  • false -- Operation failure.

Returns:

Operation result.

T_GAP_CAUSE gap_acl_update_remote_client_supported_features(uint16_t conn_handle, uint8_t client_supp_feats_len, uint8_t *p_client_supp_feats)

When receiving APP_BOND_MGR_GET_REMOTE_CLIENT_SUPPORTED_FEATURES_IND, APP shall call this API to update the client supported features.

Parameters:

  • conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle of the ACL link.

  • client_supp_feats_len -- [in] The length of the updated client supported features.

  • p_client_supp_feats -- [in] Point to the updated client supported features.

Return values:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure.

Returns:

Operation result.
